items.title_en: A modular pancreas segmentation and multimodal fusion framework for clinical and CT decision support in acute pancreatitis

items.title_cn: 肠道菌群来源的苯丙氨酸代谢物通过促进线粒体自噬和增强细胞死亡加重老年起病急性胰腺炎
items.title_en: Gut microbiota-derived phenylalanine metabolites exacerbate elderly-onset acute pancreatitis by promoting mitophagy and enhancing cell death
items.abstract_cn: 老年起病的急性胰腺炎（EOAP）表现出更高的严重程度和死亡率，然而其发病机制中与年龄相关的机制仍未完全阐明。在此，我们定义了肠道菌群失调通过改变苯丙氨酸（PA）代谢在加重EOAP严重程度中的作用。老年小鼠和老年患者表现出苯乙尿酸（PAC）和苯乙酰谷氨酰胺（PG）水平升高，同时埃希菌-志贺菌属丰度增加。来自老年供体的粪便微生物移植（FMT）在年轻受体小鼠中重现了加重的炎症表型。在机制上，PAC破坏线粒体完整性并诱导细胞凋亡，从而增强炎症反应。我们的研究结果强调了细胞凋亡失调和线粒体稳态失衡是导致EOAP严重程度的潜在机制，并提示靶向微生物PA代谢可能为EOAP提供一种新的治疗途径。视频摘要
items.abstract_en: Elderly-onset acute pancreatitis (EOAP) shows increased severity and mortality, yet the age-related mechanisms underlying its pathogenesis remain incompletely understood. Here, we define the role of gut microbiota dysbiosis in enhancing the severity of EOAP through altered phenylalanine (PA) metabolism. Aged mice and elderly patients displayed elevated phenaceturic acid (PAC) and phenylacetylglutamine (PG), along with increased Escherichia-Shigella abundance. Fecal microbiota transplantation (FMT) from aged donors reproduced the aggravated inflammatory phenotype in young recipient mice. Mechanistically, PAC compromises mitochondrial integrity and induces apoptosis, thereby enhancing inflammatory responses. Our findings highlight dysregulated apoptosis and mitochondrial homeostasis as underlying mechanisms contributing to EOAP severity, and suggest that targeting microbial PA metabolism may offer a novel therapeutic avenue for EOAP. Video Abstract
items.summary_cn: 该研究发现老年起病急性胰腺炎（EOAP）中肠道菌群失调导致苯丙氨酸代谢产物（PAC和PG）升高，且Escherichia-Shigella丰度增加；粪菌移植实验表明老年供体菌群可加重年轻受体小鼠炎症。机制上，PAC破坏线粒体完整性并诱导凋亡，从而增强炎症反应，提示靶向微生物苯丙氨酸代谢可能成为EOAP的新治疗途径。

items.title_cn: 胰腺黏液性囊性肿瘤复发破裂伴可疑主胰管相通，表现为纵隔胰腺假性囊肿、胰性胸腔积液和心包积液
items.title_en: Recurrent rupture of a pancreatic mucinous cystic neoplasm with suspected main pancreatic duct communication, presenting with a mediastinal pancreatic pseudocyst, pancreatic pleural effusion, and pericardial effusion
items.abstract_cn: 摘要 胰腺黏液性囊性肿瘤（MCN）的自发性破裂较为罕见，尤其是在妊娠期以外，且纵隔延伸尚未见报道。我们报道一例34岁女性，胰尾部MCN在计算机断层扫描（CT）上显示与主胰管连续，提示存在导管交通。该肿瘤向背侧破裂，囊液经主动脉裂孔延伸，导致纵隔胰腺假性囊肿、胰腺性胸腔积液和心包积液。胸腔积液淀粉酶为1541 IU/L。超声内镜显示囊中囊结构，术前诊断为MCN。经保守治疗后，纵隔病变消退；随后第5天症状复发，第7天CT显示在另一不同部位发生第二次破裂。第58天行远端胰腺切除联合脾切除术。组织学上，该病变为伴低级别异型增生的MCN，卵巢型间质雌激素和孕激素受体阳性。上皮剥脱和溃疡的范围远超破裂部位，提示弥漫性内壁损伤。这些发现表明，经疑似交通持续流入的胰液可能促成了反复破裂和纵隔延伸。当影像学提示此类交通时，早期手术切除可能是必要的。患者术后10年一直无复发。
items.abstract_en: Abstract Spontaneous rupture of pancreatic mucinous cystic neoplasm (MCN) is rare, particularly outside pregnancy, and mediastinal extension has not been reported. We report a 34-year-old woman with a pancreatic tail MCN demonstrating continuity with the main pancreatic duct on computed tomography (CT), suggesting ductal communication. The neoplasm ruptured dorsally, and cyst fluid extended through the aortic hiatus, resulting in a mediastinal pancreatic pseudocyst, pancreatic pleural effusion, and pericardial effusion. Pleural fluid amylase was 1541 IU/L. Endoscopic ultrasonography showed a cyst-in-cyst architecture, and a preoperative diagnosis of MCN was made. After conservative treatment, the mediastinal lesion regressed; subsequently, symptoms recurred on day 5, and CT on day 7 showed a second rupture at a distinct site. Distal pancreatectomy with splenectomy was performed on day 58. Histologically, the lesion was an MCN with low-grade dysplasia, and the ovarian-type stroma was positive for estrogen and progesterone receptors. Epithelial denudation and ulceration extended well beyond the rupture sites, indicating diffuse inner-wall injury. These findings suggest that persistent inflow of pancreatic juice through the suspected communication may have contributed to recurrent rupture and mediastinal extension. Early surgical resection may be warranted when imaging suggests such communication. The patient has remained recurrence-free for 10 years postoperatively.
items.summary_cn: 该病例报告描述了一例胰腺尾部黏液性囊性肿瘤（MCN）疑似与主胰管相通，发生两次自发性破裂并导致纵隔胰腺假性囊肿、胰性胸腔积液和心包积液，最终行远端胰切除术后10年无复发。作者提出影像学提示囊性肿瘤与胰管相通时，持续胰液流入可能促进反复破裂和纵隔延伸，早期手术切除可能是必要的。

items.title_cn: 住院急性胰腺炎患者的营养筛查：墨西哥的一项比较研究
items.title_en: Nutritional Screening in Hospitalized Patients with Acute Pancreatitis: A Comparative Study in Mexico
items.abstract_cn: 背景：急性胰腺炎（AP）是一种具有高代谢需求的急性炎症性疾病；然而，营养风险的早期识别常被低估，且对于哪种方法最能有效预测营养风险尚无普遍共识。目的：比较营养筛查方法与主观全面评估（SGA）在识别AP患者营养风险方面的一致性水平。方法：本研究为前瞻性观察性队列研究，纳入诊断为轻症或中症AP的住院患者。筛查工具：营养风险筛查-2002（NRS-2002）、营养不良通用筛查工具（MUST）、简短营养评估问卷（SNAQ）、营养不良筛查工具（MST），并通过SGA进行临床评估。结果：通过SGA评估发现55.3%的患者存在营养风险，MST为43.2%，NRS-2002和SNAQ为38.6%，MUST量表为10.6%。无营养风险患者的平均BMI显著高于有营养风险的患者（p = 0.026）。中症AP患者相比轻症AP患者，营养风险增加3.93倍（p = 0.02）。与SGA相比，NRS-2002和SNAQ量表的一致性最高。结论：营养风险在轻症和中症AP患者中高度流行，并随着临床严重程度的加重而显著增加。与SGA相比，NRS-2002和SNAQ量表具有更高的一致性和更好的表现。
items.abstract_en: Background: Acute pancreatitis (AP) is an acute inflammatory condition with high metabolic demands; however, early detection of nutritional risk is underestimated and there is no universal consensus on which is most effective for predicting nutritional risk. Objectives: To compare the level of agreement of nutritional screening methods with subjective global assessment (SGA) in identifying nutritional risk in patients with AP. Methods: This study was conducted as a prospective observational cohort in hospitalized patients diagnosed with mild or moderate AP. Screening tools: nutritional risk screening-2002 (NRS-2002), malnutrition universal screening tool (MUST), short nutritional assessment questionnaire (SNAQ), malnutrition screening tool (MST) and clinical assessment via SGA were performed. Results: Nutritional risk was found in 55.3% patients via SGA assessment, 43.2% in MST, and 38.6% in NRS-2002 and SNAQ and 10.6% in MUST scales. Patients without nutritional risk exhibited a significantly higher mean BMI than at-risk patients (p = 0.026). Patients with moderate AP exhibited a 3.93 increased risk of nutritional risk compared to those with mil AP (p = 0.02). The NRS-2002 and SNAQ scales achieved the highest agreement compared with SGA. Conclusions: Nutritional risk is highly prevalent in patients with mild and moderate AP, showing a significant increase as clinical severity progresses. The NRS-2002 and SNAQ scales had more agreement and better performance when compared with SGA.
items.summary_cn: 在住院轻中度急性胰腺炎患者中，SGA评估显示55.3%存在营养风险，且营养风险随临床严重程度增加而显著升高；NRS-2002和SNAQ量表与SGA的一致性和表现最佳。

items.title_cn: 慢性胰腺炎治疗开始后1年内手术干预与术后结局的关联：一项回顾性队列研究
items.title_en: Association of surgical intervention within 1 year of treatment initiation with postoperative outcomes in chronic pancreatitis: a retrospective cohort study

items.title_cn: KRAS驱动的代谢重编程通过增强MFSD2A介导的溶血磷脂酰胆碱清除促进胰腺导管腺癌的生存与进展
items.title_en: KRAS-driven metabolic reprogramming of enhanced MFSD2A-mediated lysophosphatidylcholine scavenging promotes survival and progression of pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma
items.abstract_cn: 致癌性KRAS驱动胰腺导管腺癌（PDAC）中的脂质重编程以促进疾病进展，而这些变化在循环中有所体现。我们采用质谱技术，对一个由93例新诊断的可切除PDAC病例、43例慢性胰腺炎患者以及93例年龄和性别匹配的健康对照组成的队列进行了血浆脂质组学分析，结果揭示了循环溶血磷脂酰胆碱（LysoPC）的显著减少是与PDAC相关的一个突出特征。利用稳定同位素解析脂质组学，我们进一步发现PDAC细胞表现出一种脂质清除表型，其特征是优先摄取细胞外不饱和LysoPC以维持促生长信号。限制细胞外不饱和LysoPC的生物利用度使PDAC细胞的代谢表型转向增强的从头脂肪生成和自噬，并伴随AKT信号活性的抑制和凋亡易感性的增加。利用批量、单细胞和空间转录组数据集以及功能实验，我们确定了致癌性KRAS介导的主要促进子超家族结构域包含蛋白2a（MFSD2A）上调是促进PDAC细胞摄取细胞外LysoPC的关键介质。MFSD2A表达的缺失模拟了LysoPC限制，导致AKT信号抑制和PDAC细胞在体外凋亡倾向增加，并在体内抑制肿瘤生长。通过重新利用合成烷基溶血磷脂依地福新（edelfosine）对KRAS-MFSD2A-LysoPC轴进行治疗性靶向，在体外产生了强效的抗癌效果，其机制归因于细胞外LysoPC摄取的减少和AKT信号的减弱。总之，我们的发现描述了一种此前未被认识的增强LysoPC清除的肿瘤代谢程序，该程序由MFSD2A介导，促进PDAC进展，并可通过重新利用依地福新进行治疗性靶向。
items.abstract_en: Oncogenic KRAS drives lipid reprogramming in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) to promote disease progression, and these changes are manifest in circulation. Using mass spectrometry, we performed lipidomic analyses on plasmas from a cohort of 93 newly-diagnosed resectable PDAC cases, 43 patients with chronic pancreatitis, and 93 age- and sex-matched healthy controls, the results of which revealed pronounced reductions in circulating lysophosphatidylcholines (LysoPC) as a prominent feature associated with PDAC. Using stable-isotope resolved lipidomics, we further found that PDAC cells exhibit a lipid scavenging phenotype characterized by preferential uptake of extracellular unsaturated LysoPCs to sustain pro-growth signals. Restricting bioavailability of extracellular unsaturated LysoPCs shifted the metabolic phenotype of PDAC cells towards enhanced de novo lipogenesis and autophagy, which was accompanied by suppression of AKT signaling activities and increased susceptibility to apoptosis. Using bulk, single-cell, and spatial transcriptomic datasets together with functional experiments, we identified oncogenic KRAS-mediated upregulation of major facilitator superfamily domain-containing protein 2a (MFSD2A) as a key mediator that facilitates extracellular uptake of LysoPCs in PDAC cells. Loss of MFSD2A expression mimicked LysoPC restriction and resulted in inhibition of AKT signaling and increased propensity of PDAC cells to undergo apoptosis in vitro and suppressed tumor growth in vivo. Therapeutic targeting of the KRAS-MFSD2A-LysoPC axis via repurposing of the synthetic alkyl-lysophospholipid edelfosine promoted potent anti-cancer effects in vitro that were mechanistically attributed to reduced extracellular uptake of LysoPCs, and attenuation of AKT signaling. Collectively, our findings describe a previously unrecognized onco-metabolic program of enhanced LysoPC scavenging mediated by MFSD2A that promotes PDAC progression and that is therapeutically targetable via repurposing edelfosine.
items.summary_cn: 该研究发现PDAC血浆中溶血磷脂酰胆碱（LysoPC）显著降低，KRAS上调MFSD2A介导细胞外不饱和LysoPC的摄取以维持促生长信号，限制LysoPC可抑制AKT信号并增加凋亡；靶向KRAS-MFSD2A-LysoPC轴（如老药edelfosine）在体外表现出抗癌效果。

items.title_cn: 慢性胰腺炎中细胞因子谱和外分泌胰腺功能与基于症状的脱水分类及就诊季节的关联：一项回顾性研究
items.title_en: ASSOCIATIONS OF CYTOKINE PROFILE AND EXOCRINE PANCREATIC FUNCTION WITH A SYMPTOM-BASED DEHYDRATION CATEGORY AND SEASON OF PRESENTATION IN CHRONIC PANCREATITIS: A RETROSPECTIVE STUDY.
items.abstract_cn: 目的：评估C反应蛋白（CRP）、粪便弹性蛋白酶-1（FE-1）、白细胞介素-2受体（IL-2R）、白细胞介素-6（IL-6）和转化生长因子-β1（TGF-β1）与慢性胰腺炎中基于症状的脱水分类及就诊季节之间的关联；临床组间比较为次要目的。材料与方法：在2023-2025年筛查的132份连续住院病历中，分析了80份具有五项实验室结局完整结果的记录，排除了52份不完整记录；每位患者贡献一次观察数据。未调整的Kruskal-Wallis、Mann-Whitney U和Spearman分析采用Holm校正。五个线性模型采用HC3稳健标准误，同时校正脱水分类、夏季就诊、临床组、年龄、性别和病程。结果：未调整分析显示，较高的脱水分类与较高的CRP和IL-6以及较低的FE-1相关。经相互校正后，仅IL-6仍与脱水分类每增加一个等级相关（+36.94 pg/mL；95% CI，17.98-55.90；Holm校正p=0.0011）。夏季就诊独立与较高的CRP（+8.46 mg/L）和IL-6（+44.23 pg/mL）、较低的FE-1（-22.89 µg/g）以及较低的TGF-β1（-61.12 pg/mL）相关（所有Holm校正p<0.05），但与IL-2R无关。五项结局在临床组间无差异。结论：经校正后，脱水分类仅与IL-6保持独立关联，而夏季就诊仍与CRP、IL-6、FE-1和TGF-β1保持关联。回顾性观察性设计无法将因果关系归因于高温或脱水。
items.abstract_en: AIM: To evaluate the associations of C-reactive protein (CRP), fecal elastase-1 (FE-1), interleukin-2 receptor (IL-2R), interleukin-6 (IL-6), and transforming growth factor-beta 1 (TGF-β1) with the symptom-based dehydration category and season of presentation in chronic pancreatitis; clinical-group comparisons were secondary. MATERIALS AND METHODS: Of 132 consecutive inpatient records screened in 2023-2025, 80 with complete results for the five laboratory outcomes were analyzed and 52 incomplete records were excluded; each patient contributed one observation. Unadjusted Kruskal-Wallis, Mann-Whitney U, and Spearman analyses used Holm correction. Five linear models with HC3 robust standard errors simultaneously adjusted for dehydration category, summer presentation, clinical group, age, sex, and disease duration. RESULTS: Unadjusted analyses associated higher dehydration category with higher CRP and IL-6 and lower FE-1. After mutual adjustment, only IL-6 remained associated with each one-category increase in dehydration (+36.94 pg/mL; 95% CI, 17.98-55.90; Holm-adjusted p=0.0011). Summer presentation was independently associated with higher CRP (+8.46 mg/L) and IL-6 (+44.23 pg/mL), lower FE-1 (-22.89 µg/g), and lower TGF-β1 (-61.12 pg/mL) (all Holm-adjusted p<0.05), but not IL-2R. The five outcomes did not differ across clinical groups. CONCLUSION: After adjustment, dehydration category remained independently associated only with IL-6, whereas summer presentation retained associations with CRP, IL-6, FE-1, and TGF-β1. The retrospective observational design precludes causal attribution to heat or dehydration.
items.summary_cn: 在慢性胰腺炎患者中，相互校正后脱水分级仅与IL-6独立相关（每增加一级+36.94 pg/mL），而夏季就诊独立关联于较高的CRP和IL-6、较低的FE-1和TGF-β1；五项指标在临床分组间无差异。

items.title_cn: 用于超快生物粘附和黏膜下注射的水凝胶
items.title_en: Hydrogels for ultrafast bio-adhesion and submucosal injection
items.abstract_en: Bio-adhesive hydrogels and lifting gels comprising sodium alginate and their use for preventing or controlling a gastrointestinal bleed or hemorrhage or sealing a perforation in tissue of a GI tract and separating diseased tissue from normal tissue in the GI tract, respectively, are disclosed. The hydrogel forms a calcium alginate barrier at the bleeding site, addressing the limitations of current endoscopic treatments for gastrointestinal bleeding which have limited efficacy, high recurrence of bleeding, and obscuration of the endoscopy view.
items.abstract_cn: 本发明公开了包含海藻酸钠的生物粘附水凝胶和抬举凝胶，分别用于预防或控制胃肠道出血或止血、封闭胃肠道组织穿孔，以及将病变组织与正常组织分离。该水凝胶在出血部位形成海藻酸钙屏障，解决了当前胃肠道出血内镜治疗疗效有限、再出血率高、以及内镜视野被血液遮挡的问题。同时可作为黏膜下注射抬举凝胶用于ESD术中组织分离。
items.summary_cn: 该专利由约翰斯·霍普金斯大学研发，提出一种基于海藻酸钠和CaCl₂的生物粘附水凝胶，在内镜下喷洒至出血部位后迅速形成海藻酸钙屏障实现止血。其核心创新在于兼具止血和黏膜下抬举双重功能：既能控制急性出血和迟发性出血，又能在ESD术中作为抬举凝胶分离病变组织与正常组织。优势在于减少多种内镜配件的使用需求，缩短操作时间，适用于难以精确定位的弥漫性出血和肿瘤出血场景。
items.assignee: JOHNS HOPKINS UNIVERSITY（美国约翰斯·霍普金斯大学）

items.title_cn: 用于机器人辅助手术的内镜多装夹施夹器
items.title_en: Endoscopic clip applier for robotic-assisted surgery
items.abstract_en: An endoscopic multi-load clip applier device includes a housing structured to include a compartment operable to store and distribute one or more clips; a flexible end coupled to the housing; and at least two grip components coupled to the housing and operable to compress and release upon control by robotic forceps of a robotic-assisted surgery system. The device enables multiple clip storage and automatic reloading, enhancing surgical efficiency and surgeon control in robotic-assisted surgery. The instrument can be introduced into an operative field via a bedside assistant port, and the surgeon can pick up the device using robotic forceps to place clips at the surgical site.
items.abstract_cn: 一���内镜多装夹施夹器装置，包括可存储和分发多个钛夹的壳体、连接于壳体的柔性端部、以及至少两个夹持组件。夹持组件可由机器人辅助手术系统的机械钳控制压缩和释放，使术者可在术中多次放置钛夹。该装置支持多夹存储和自动重装，提升机器人辅助手术中的效率和术者操控性。器械可通过床旁助手端口引入手术区域，术者使用机械钳夹取器械端部并在手术部位放置钛夹。
items.summary_cn: 该专利由加州大学研发，针对机器人辅助手术中血管结扎的痛点，设计了一种可存储多个钛夹并自动重装的内镜施夹器。核心创新在于将柔性端部设计与机器人机械钳操控相结合，术者可在不更换器械的情况下连续放置多个止血夹，大幅提升手术效率。该装置为一次性使用，成本低于现有技术，适用于机器人辅助的消化道手术中血管处理。
items.assignee: UNIVERSITY OF CALIFORNIA（美国加州大学）
